subject: Qualification: Deployment mode & PoC plan - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion / next steps

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick post-call recap and a proposed PoC/trial plan so we can align on success criteria and deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private). Please review and confirm or flag anything missing.

Summary of requirements we heard:
- Latency: ~200ms 99p for synchronous generation (supporting < 1s response for our UI flows)
- Throughput: initial pilot 50 qps sustained, spikes to 150 qps for batch jobs
- Data residency: customer data must not leave US regions; potential need for VPC or on-prem for regulated datasets
- Security: SOC 2 + KMS-based key management desired; Acme will share questionnaire
- Budget sensitivity: looking to cap monthly inference spend for pilot

Proposed PoC (4 weeks):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + access (API keys, test dataset)
2) Week 1: Integration with Hosted API — baseline perf and quality metrics
3) Week 2: If needed, run Dedicated capacity trial (reserved pool) — perf & cost comparison
4) Week 3: If security gating requires, stand up Private VPC trial (customer-managed VPC) — verify audit logs, KMS integration
5) Week 4: Evaluate against success criteria + decision / next steps

Success criteria (suggested):
- Latency SLO: p95 < 400ms for interactive flows
- Throughput: sustain 50 qps with <10% error rate
- Quality: model responses pass our shared 50-case evaluation set with >= 90% acceptance
- Security: SOC 2 evidence & KMS integration + network controls validated for Private option

Attachments: acme_poc_plan_v1.pdf (detailed timeline & contacts).

Next actions: can you confirm which deployment mode you'd like to prioritize for the pilot (Hosted first, or go straight to Dedicated/Private)? Also, please share the security questionnaire and any timeline constraints.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m follow-up if helpful.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion / next steps

Jordan —

Thanks for the thorough recap. This matches our notes. A couple clarifications from Acme security and infra:

- We need SOC 2 evidence and a high-level architecture diagram showing KMS integration before we can allow any PII-containing traffic to go to a hosted/shared environment.
- Ideally we’d prefer Dedicated capacity in a customer-isolated tenant (or Private VPC if that’s simpler for our compliance team) for the pilot, but we are open to a short hosted baseline run to compare latency/cost as long as the data involved is anonymized.
- Stakeholders: Myself (AI Product Lead), Tom (Platform/Infra), and our Security Manager, Priya Singh (cc’d on follow-ups once we have the SOC info).

I attached our internal PoC checklist (acme_internal_requirements.docx) and SOC questions. Please send SOC 2 evidence and the redwood dedicated vs hosted comparison when available.

For next steps: Can Ben scope the Dedicated & Private options with rough infra/time estimates? We’d like a kickoff week of March 9 if possible.

Thanks,
Alice

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion / next steps

Hi Alice — Jordan —

Quick technical scoping based on the call and Alice’s list:

Option A — Hosted API (fastest to start)
- Pros: <24h onboarding, no infra ops, easy to iterate on prompts
- Cons: Shared tenant; need to anonymize or omit sensitive PII from hosted run
- Work: Send us a 100-case anonymized evaluation set; we’ll run baseline perf and cost.

Option B — Redwood Dedicated (customer-dedicated GPU pool)
- Pros: Isolated compute, predictable throughput, faster than provisioning private infra
- Cons: Requires reserved capacity commit for longer pilots; setup 2-3 days for config + routing
- Work: We’ll propose an initial capacity profile (e.g., 4x A100 equiv) and expected throughput numbers. See attached: redwood-dedicated-vs-hosted-comparison.xlsx

Option C — Private VPC / On-prem
- Pros: Full control for compliance teams, KMS/HSM integration, network controls
- Cons: Longer setup (2–4 weeks depending on network), additional SW package install for on-prem
- Work: We’ll need your infra team to open a pilot VPC peering diagram and agree on firewall rules.

Recommended path (pragmatic): Start with a short anonymized Hosted baseline (1 week) to measure quality and latency, then spin up Dedicated capacity for the full 3-week pilot to validate sustained throughput and cost. If security gates remain, move to Private VPC in parallel with a limited test set.

Estimated timeline to meet March 9 kickoff: send us the anonymized dataset + completed security checklist by March 4; we’ll provision keys and a test host by March 8.

Let me know if you want me to include our infra contact (Marissa) on the kickoff call to walk through Dedicated vs Private specifics — looping her on this thread.

— Ben
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion / next steps

Thanks team — appreciate the quick turn.

Action items & confirmed plan:
- Acme will provide anonymized 100-case evaluation set + completed security checklist by end of day 2026-03-04 (Alice).
- Redwood will run Hosted baseline (1 week) starting 2026-03-09 and provision test API keys by 2026-03-08 (Ben / Marissa).
- If Hosted baseline is acceptable for quality, we will provision Redwood Dedicated trial for weeks 2–3 to validate sustained throughput and cost. If not, we will fast-follow with Private VPC setup (timeline 2–4 weeks) pending infra approvals.
- Marissa will send the SOC 2 redacted pack + audit contact and the Dedicated vs Hosted spreadsheet to the group after this mail.

Proposed kickoff: 30m on 2026-03-09 10:00 AM PT — I’ll send a calendar invite once Alice confirms.

Please reply with any blockers; otherwise I’ll mark the kickoff tentative and share the Drive links (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmePoC).

— Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
